title: Why financial prices exhibit Brownian motion despite predictable order flow: An exactly solvable nonlinear price impact model
abstract: arXiv:2502.17906v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In econophysics, there are two enigmatic empirical laws of financial market microstructure: (i) the market-order flow has predictable persistence due to metaorder splitting by institutional investors, as formulated by the Lillo--Mike--Farmer model. However, this phenomenon seems paradoxical given the diffusive and unpredictable price dynamics. (ii) The price impact $I(Q_{\rm tot})$ of a large metaorder $Q_{\rm tot}$ follows the square-root law, $I(Q_{\rm tot})\propto \sqrt{Q_{\rm tot}}$. In this Letter, we reveal why price dynamics follows Brownian motion despite predictable order flow by unifying these enigmas via an exactly solvable model. We generalize the Lillo--Mike--Farmer model to nonlinear price-impact dynamics, which is mapped to a solvable L\'evy-walk model. translated_title: 为什么金融价格在订单流可预测的情况下仍呈现布朗运动：一个精确可解的非线性价格冲击模型
translated_abstract: 在经济物理学中，金融市场微观结构存在两条神秘的实证规律：（i）由于机构投资者将大额订单拆分执行，市场订单流呈现出可预测的持续性，正如 Lillo–Mike–Farmer 模型所描述的那样。然而，考虑到价格动态的扩散性与不可预测性，这一现象似乎构成悖论。（ii）大额订单 $Q_{\rm tot}$ 的价格冲击 $I(Q_{\rm tot})$ 遵循平方根定律，即 $I(Q_{\rm tot})\propto \sqrt{Q_{\rm tot}}$。在这篇快报中，我们通过一个精确可解的模型统一了这两个谜题，揭示了为何尽管订单流可预测，价格动态仍遵循布朗运动。我们将 Lillo–Mike–Farmer 模型推广至非线性价格冲击动力学，并将其映射到一个可解的 Lévy 游走模型。我们的精确解表明，在平方根定律下，即使订单流具有持续性，价格动态仍保持扩散性，这反映了（截断处：有限方差……）
tldr: 本文提出一个精确可解的非线性价格冲击模型，通过将 Lillo–Mike–Farmer 模型推广并映射到可解的 Lévy 游走模型，证明了即使订单流具有可预测的持续性且价格冲击遵循平方根定律，价格动态仍然保持布朗（扩散）运动，从而统一解释了市场微观结构中的两大谜题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an exactly solvable nonlinear price impact model that generalizes the Lillo–Mike–Farmer framework and maps it to a solvable Lévy-walk model, proving that price dynamics remains Brownian (diffusive) even under persistent, predictable order flow with square-root impact, thereby unifying two major puzzles of market microstructure.
